candidate.answerReason: Each progression has sum \(S_p=1600p-780\), so summing for \(p=1,\ldots,10\) gives \(80{,}200\).

methods.label: Find each progression's sum
methods.explanation:
For a fixed \(p\), the \(40\)th term is \(p+39(2p-1)\). Pair the first term with the last, the second with the next-to-last, and so on. Equal spacing makes every pair have the same sum, and there are \(20\) pairs. Therefore
\[
\begin{aligned}
S_p
&=20\bigl[2p+39(2p-1)\bigr]\\
&=20(80p-39)\\
&=1600p-780.
\end{aligned}
\]
This expression makes summing over the ten values of \(p\) straightforward. Since
\[
1+2+\cdots+10=\frac{10\cdot11}{2}=55,
\]
we obtain
\[
\begin{aligned}
S_1+S_2+\cdots+S_{10}
&=1600\cdot55-780\cdot10\\
&=88{,}000-7{,}800\\
&=80{,}200.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
